asks: Asks the commission not to add Peace River and Manning to Central Peace-Notley and to drop the Peace River-Notley name; suggests Sexsmith if population is needed.
Prefers option 71B and an Okotoks-Diamond Valley arrangement, and says Livingstone-Macleod should run east-west toward Lethbridge with no communities north on Highway 2.

quote: For Livingstone Macleod, from the west and south ends Lethbridge is our natural economic corridor.
note: Lethbridge named as the economic corridor for Livingstone-Macleod; nothing said about how the city itself is districted. 'Proposed Jasper-Banff' is named only as a comparison, with no link to Rocky Mountain House.

asks: Asks that Beaumont be kept whole under one representative.
Supports the interim Banff-Jasper division and asks that it be named Canmore-Banff-Jasper.
Thanks the commission for keeping the two Lethbridge ridings solely inside the city and following 13 Street; asks for nothing more.

quote: I also appreciate how you stayed true to the 116-year old precedent that guides the Lethbridge ridings by staying solely within the boundary of the City of Lethbridge with the borders of these two constituencies.
note: Approves the interim arrangement; says Lethbridge has different needs than its neighbours.

asks: Asks that Medicine Hat be separated from Brooks and paired again with Cypress County in a Cypress-Medicine Hat riding.
Supports the interim Edmonton-Whitemud riding and asks for one more Edmonton seat, with urban ridings not diluted by rural voters.
Asks that annexed agricultural land be left out of Red Deer-North so it stays a clearly urban district.

quote: I encourage the Commission to revisit this aspect of the Interim Report and to preserve the integrity of Red Deer-North as a clearly urban electoral district.
note: Objects to annexed agricultural land (inside the new city limits, taken from Innisfail-Sylvan Lake) being put in Red Deer-North, calling the result 'effectively a hybrid urban-rural riding'. Wants a city-only district, narrower even than the city limits. Not coded as a rejection of R2: the four-way plan is not what she is arguing against.

asks: Agrees with the interim Edmonton-West Henday boundaries; no further request.
Thanks the commission for rejecting four hybrid ridings for Lethbridge and asks that Lethbridge be kept whole and urban.

quote: really thank you for rejecting the literal drawing and quartering of the City of Lethbridge into four “rurban” or hybrid ridings
note: Names Lethbridge-Little Bow as the riding he would have been in. Also p. 57: 'Keep Lethbridge whole and allow the surrounding communities also be whole.'

asks: Supports the interim Banff-Jasper riding and asks that Canmore be in its name, with some allowance for its size.
Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).

Asks that Clearwater County, western Mountain View County, the M.D. of Bighorn and Banff National Park be put in one Eastern Slopes constituency instead of the interim Mountain View-Kneehill arrangement.

quote: I urge the Commission to change these boundaries and ensure that Eastern Slopes communities of Clearwater County, western Mountain View County, M.D. of Bighorn, and Banff National Park are represented in the same constituency.
note: Sundre-area resident (header: Clearwater County; current division Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre). Wants Clearwater County and western Mountain View County in one foothills riding, not with communities east of Highway 2. Rocky Mountain House appears only in the interim riding name.

quote: I urge the Commission to change these boundaries and ensure that Eastern Slopes communities of Clearwater County, western Mountain View County, M.D. of Bighorn, and Banff National Park are represented in the same constituency.
note: Asks outright for the M.D. of Bighorn and Banff National Park to share a constituency with Clearwater County. Does not say whether the Banff or Canmore townsites are included, and sets the region apart from 'the Bow Valley corridor and Kananaskis'.

quote: A better alternative to the proposed Mountain View-Kneehill riding would be to bring together those common tourism areas in western Mountain View County, Clearwater County, M.D. of Bighorn, and Banff National Park.
note: Wants western Mountain View County (Sundre area) out of the prairie riding and with the foothills; gives no line such as Highway 22 and says nothing of Crossfield, Irricana or Beiseker.

asks: Asks that northern representation, an independent process and consultation be protected in any reform of the boundary review; names no riding change.
States concerns with the proposed Strathcona-Sherwood Park boundaries without saying what they are; no specific request.
Thanks the commission for keeping Calgary ridings inside the city and asks for one more Calgary seat inside city limits.
Asks that Beaumont not be divided between two ridings.
Asks that the southwest corner of Wheatland County around Carseland, north of the Bow River, stay with Strathmore in the same district.

note: Chestermere appears only in the riding name. The request is about keeping southwest Wheatland County with Strathmore. Says the area is 'distinct from Calgary and its bedroom communities' but asks nothing about Chestermere.

asks: Asks that Calgary-Acadia keep its current boundaries.
Commends the interim Banff-Jasper riding, including the removal of Elbow Valley and Springbank and the addition of two Stoney reserves; no change requested.
Asks for a district around the Shepard growth area that joins adjacent south Chestermere communities with eastern Calgary (Calgary-Peigan).

quote: it makes sense to set a district boundary around this historic Prairie Economic Gateway project, which includes the Shepard growth area, the adjacent Chestermere communities, and eastern Calgary communities
note: Chestermere resident. Proposes joining south Chestermere and the Shepard area with Calgary-Peigan ('Including this area with Calgary-Peigan creates a geographically coherent district'). Only the part of Chestermere next to Shepard, not the whole city.

asks: Asks that Strathcona-Sherwood Park keep its 2023 boundaries: Heritage Hills kept in, and no part of Beaumont or Leduc County added.
Asks that the Lesser Slave Lake division be maintained, with Swan Hills added.

quote: On behalf of the Lesser Slave Lake constituency we support maintaining the LSLC electoral division
note: Header: current Lesser Slave Lake, about Mackenzie. Opens 'Re the dissolving of the Lesser Slave River'. Asks that Swan Hills be added, with section 15(2) status.

asks: Asks that Clearwater County be kept together with Sundre, the M.D. of Bighorn and other communities west of Highway 22, not put in Banff-Jasper.

quote: A much better option would be to keep Clearwater County and other communities west of Highway 22 like Sundre and M.D. of Bighorn together
note: Rocky Mountain House resident. Objects to western Clearwater County going to Banff-Jasper (part of the interim division of the county) but does not use words rejecting the three-way division as a whole, so W3 is not entered under rejects.

quote: I read the Commission’s report and have concerns that the Banff-Jasper riding will severely limit the representation of people living in Clearwater County west of Rocky Mountain House.
note: The quote shows the rejection of B3. The want is in the same paragraph: 'keep Clearwater County and other communities west of Highway 22 like Sundre and M.D. of Bighorn together'. He asks for the M.D. of Bighorn with Clearwater County but does not mention the park or the Stoney reserves, so direction only.

quote: A much better option would be to keep Clearwater County and other communities west of Highway 22 like Sundre and M.D. of Bighorn together
note: Sundre with Clearwater County, west of Highway 22 (codebook: O1 here, W1 under RMH-A). Says nothing else about the Olds riding.

asks: Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Asks that Beaumont be kept whole in one division, preferably with Leduc and part of Leduc County.
Asks that Red Deer-North boundaries stay unchanged, with the annexed rural lands left out.

quote: I believe and ask that RD-North electoral boundaries remain unchanged as the addition of those rural lands which may not be developed for residential use for some time remain out of our electoral boundary
note: Wants Red Deer-North kept as in 2023, without the annexed rural lands; 'Our "city" boundaries should remain respected'.

asks: Commends keeping Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West as city ridings and asks that urban Lethbridge not be diluted with surrounding rural areas.

quote: I would like to commend the commission on making the recommendation that Lethbridge KEEPS it current consistencies of Lethbridge East and Lethbridge West.
note: Rejection is of joining the city to the rural areas around it in general, not of the four-way plan by name: 'What is important to me is that we do not dilute urban concerns and needs with the desires of the rural constituencies that surround us.' A stricter reader could leave rejects blank.

asks: Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Asks that Arbour Lake and Citadel be kept in the same Calgary riding and that Hamptons move to Calgary-Foothills.
Supports the interim changes to Calgary-Klein; no further request.
Thanks the commission for keeping Edmonton-City Centre inside the city, and asks that rural areas such as Westlock not be combined with urban areas such as St. Albert or Edmonton.

quote: these areas have unique advocacy needs that would be diminished by lumping them in with St. Albert for example which has access to a large hospital
note: St. Albert named as an example of an urban area that rural Westlock should not be joined to. Nothing about St. Albert and Sturgeon County.

asks: Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Says urban areas should stay urban and rural stay rural in Red Deer-North, objecting to rural areas being added to it.

quote: As such I believe that urban areas should remain urban and rural remain rural.
note: Header and subject line: Red Deer-North boundary changes. Refers to 'the rural communities being added' and says too many rural voices 'may dilute the voices of the citizens of Red Deer'. No explicit request sentence beyond the quote.

asks: Asks that Lethbridge-West and Lethbridge-East remain urban only, and for more urban ridings.

quote: My issues are mostly different than those of rural voters and would not be represented if Lethbridge West were to include rural areas in a ploy to dilute the voting power of Lethbridge residents. Lethbridge West should remain urban only, as should Lethbridge East.
note: Reacts to the idea of adding rural areas to the Lethbridge ridings, which the interim map did not do. The rejection is of city-country joining in general; the four-way plan is not described.

asks: Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Asks that Red Deer-North keep its 2023 boundaries and that urban and rural not be combined.

quote: Please keep the boundaries for the Red Deer North riding the same as the last provincial election in 2023.
note: Also: 'To properly represent the people, urban and rural should not be combined.' Reads the interim addition of annexed land as combining urban and rural.

asks: Asks that Trochu be included in the Innisfail constituency.

quote: I strongly believe that Trochu should be included in the upcoming Innisfail provincial constituency.
note: Trochu-with-Innisfail letter (codebook, REDDEER note): mention only. Red Deer itself is never named.

quote: I strongly believe that Trochu should be included in the upcoming Innisfail provincial constituency.
note: Trochu is in Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills now and in the Olds or Mountain View riding on every map; the writer asks for it to go to the Innisfail riding but never names the Olds riding. Left without a want under the doubt rule; a second reader could enter O9.

asks: Asks the commission to keep the existing Leduc-Beaumont boundaries and not split Beaumont.
Asks that the additional south Edmonton seat in the interim report actually be added, not moved from elsewhere.
Thanks the commission for the new southeast Edmonton riding and asks that it not come at the cost of a riding in the core.
Raises general concerns that boundary changes split communities and dilute voices; asks for caution and no specific change.
Asks that Ponoka, Lacombe and Blackfalds and their two counties be kept in one division, rather than Lacombe with Rocky Mountain House and Ponoka with Wetaskiwin.

quote: In my opinion the new proposal of putting Lacombe with Rocky Mountain House and Ponoka with Wetaskiwin does not provide the same level of common interest and concerns.
note: Ponoka resident, writing from the Lacombe side. Argues against pairing Lacombe with Rocky Mountain House as such, which is what W2 does; the interim Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House riding he reacts to held only part of Clearwater County. Wants Ponoka, Lacombe and Blackfalds and their counties together. Says nothing about Clearwater County or Sundre.
Red Deer named only as a nearby centre ('proximity to Red Deer', 'the Red Deer River'). Says larger urban areas do not fit with rural areas, without naming Red Deer in that sentence.

asks: Asks that Clearwater County be kept whole in one riding with other west-central communities, not divided among three.

quote: my concerns with the decision by the commission to eliminate the Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding and break up Clearwater County into three different constituencies
note: Also: 'keep all communities in Clearwater County in the same riding with other west central communities'. Says she has a connection 'to the mountains, not to the prairies', but names no park or Bighorn land, so no RMH-B line.

asks: Asks the commission to drop the Calgary-Okotoks hybrid and adopt the Plan B Okotoks-Diamond Valley model.
Asks that Strathcona-Sherwood Park boundaries stay unchanged, with Tofield added if more population is needed, not Beaumont.
Asks that the Wheatland County area around Carseland, north of the Bow River, stay with Strathmore.

note: Chestermere appears only in the riding name in the form header. The request is to keep the Carseland area with Strathmore. 'County of Lethbridge border' is a landmark, not a statement about the city.

asks: Asks that Strathcona-Sherwood Park keep its 2023 boundaries, without parts of Beaumont and Leduc County.
Asks the commission to reconsider the Central Peace-Notley changes and let more northern constituencies sit below the population threshold under section 15(2).

note: The form header lists 'Central Peace-Notley; Peace River; Slave Lake, etc' and the letter speaks of 'proposed changes to other northern constituencies' weakening the north, but it makes no request about Lesser Slave Lake.

asks: Asks that the interim Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville boundary stay unchanged, keeping the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in it (campaign text).
Asks that Strathcona-Sherwood Park keep its 2023 boundaries and not be merged with Beaumont.
Objects to the interim line between Lethbridge-West and Lethbridge-East and asks that Lethbridge-West not extend east across the Oldman River.

quote: it would be entirely inappropriate to extend the boundary of the West Lethbridge electoral district across the river
note: Reacts to the interim line between the two city ridings and wants Lethbridge-West kept west of the Oldman River. This is about the line inside the city, not about joining city and country, so no option is entered. Both ridings are assumed to stay inside the city.

asks: Asks that Montgomery stay in Calgary-Bow with Bowness, not move to Calgary-Varsity.
Asks that Edmonton's core get another seat and that Edmonton-City Centre not be expanded or merged with unlike areas.
Asks that Jasper, Banff and Canmore be placed in one provincial constituency.
Asks that districts be kept as they are, with urban and rural areas not mixed in hybrid ridings.
Asks the commission to reconsider the four-quadrant hybrid model for Lethbridge.

quote: I encourage the boundary commission to reconsider the four-quadrant hybrid model for Lethbridge.
note: Lethbridge County resident (current division Taber-Warner). 'Reconsider' here means take up again: the letter goes on to argue for the model ('The hybrid model embeds that interdependence into representation'). The interim map did not adopt it.

asks: Approves the interim Red Deer-North constituency and asks that urban and rural constituencies be kept distinct.

quote: I think you did a very good job in addressing the constituency of Red Deer North, which is where I reside.
note: Approves the interim Red Deer-North and adds that his 'main concern is that we adequately differentiate between urban and rural constituency boundaries'.
